statements.impact_statement: The over-read needs an application that passes XML_ParseBuffer a length larger than the buffer XML_GetBuffer returned. In this image the only program that loaded libexpat was git-http-push (git's WebDAV push for dumb HTTP remotes; agents push over smart HTTP), and the build deletes it (scan of all ELF files at digest sha256:031d71bb8919e0b887776d430439a44ed0efabd1704bebc739854b7037cfd110 on 2026-10-18). check-expat-users.mjs fails the build if any ELF file names libexpat.so.1 again. The libexpat package stays because apk's git depends on it. dhi.io's Alpine 3.24 repository (built 2026-10-17) has no libexpat 2.9.0-r0 with the fix yet; remove this statement once the base carries it.
